function Tdfunc(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(m) = 4;
  m[0] = 1.0;
  m[1] = 1.0;
  m[2] = 1.0;
  m[3] = 1.0;
end

function Ubou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(ub) = 4;
  ub[0] = 0.0;
  ub[1] = 0.0;
  ub[2] = 0.0;
  ub[3] = 0.0;
end

function Fbou(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 4;
  fb[0] = 0.0;
  fb[1] = 0.0;
  fb[2] = 0.0;
  fb[3] = 0.0;
end

function FbouHdg(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
  output_size(fb) = 28;
  fb[0] = mu[4]-uhat[0];
  fb[1] = mu[5]-uhat[1];
  fb[2] = mu[6]-uhat[2];
  fb[3] = mu[7]-uhat[3];
  fb[4] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[5] = uq[1]-uhat[1];
  fb[6] = uq[2]-uhat[2];
  fb[7] = uq[3]-uhat[3];
  fb[8] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[9] = -uhat[1];
  fb[10] = -uhat[2];
  fb[11] = -uhat[3]+(mu[8]*mu[10]*uhat[0])/mu[9];
  fb[12] = uq[8]+tau[0]*(uq[0]-uhat[0]);
  fb[13] = (uq[9]-(uq[8]*uhat[1])/uhat[0])/uhat[0]+tau[0]*(uq[1]-uhat[1]);
  fb[14] = (uq[10]-(uq[8]*uhat[2])/uhat[0])/uhat[0]-tau[0]*uhat[2];
  fb[15] = tau[0]*(uq[3]-uhat[3])-(1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*(uhat[0]*(mu[0]-1.0)*(-uq[11]+uq[8]*((1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*(uhat[1]*uhat[1]))/2.0+(1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*(uhat[2]*uhat[2]))/2.0)+uhat[0]*(1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*uhat[1]*(uq[9]-(uq[8]*uhat[1])/uhat[0])+1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*uhat[2]*(uq[10]-(uq[8]*uhat[2])/uhat[0])))+uq[8]*(uhat[3]-uhat[0]*((1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*(uhat[1]*uhat[1]))/2.0+(1.0/(uhat[0]*uhat[0])*(uhat[2]*uhat[2]))/2.0))*(mu[0]-1.0)))/(mu[0]-1.0);
  fb[16] = tau[0]*(uq[0]-uhat[0]);
  fb[17] = -tau[0]*(-uq[1]+uhat[1]+n[0]*(n[0]*uq[1]+n[1]*uq[2]));
  fb[18] = -tau[0]*(-uq[2]+uhat[2]+n[1]*(n[0]*uq[1]+n[1]*uq[2]));
  fb[19] = tau[0]*(uq[3]-uhat[3]);
  fb[20] = n[0]*uq[4]+n[1]*uq[8]+tau[0]*(uq[0]-uhat[0]);
  fb[21] = n[0]*uq[5]+n[1]*uq[9]+tau[0]*(uq[1]-uhat[1]);
  fb[22] = n[0]*uq[6]+n[1]*uq[10]+tau[0]*(uq[2]-uhat[2]);
  fb[23] = n[0]*uq[7]+n[1]*uq[11]+tau[0]*(uq[3]-uhat[3]);
  fb[24] = uq[0]-uhat[0];
  fb[25] = -uhat[1];
  fb[26] = -uhat[2];
  fb[27] = 0.0;
end

function Initu(x, eta, mu)
  output_size(ui) = 4;
  ui[0] = mu[4];
  ui[1] = mu[5];
  ui[2] = mu[6];
  ui[3] = mu[7];
end

function HeatFlux(x, uhat, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)  
    output_size(f) = 2;

    gam = mu[0];
    gam1 = gam - 1.0;
    Re = mu[1];
    Pr = mu[2];
    Minf = mu[3];
    Tref = mu[9];
    muRef = 1/Re;
    M2 = Minf*Minf;
    c23 = 2.0/3.0;
    pinf = 1.0/(gam*M2);
    Tinf = pinf/(gam-1.0);

    r = uhat[0];
    ru = uhat[1];
    rv = uhat[2];
    rE = uhat[3];
    rx = uq[4];
    rux = uq[5];
    rvx = uq[6];
    rEx = uq[7];
    ry = uq[8];
    ruy = uq[9];
    rvy = uq[10];
    rEy = uq[11];

    av = v[0];

    r1 = 1/r;
    uv = ru*r1;
    vv = rv*r1;
    E = rE*r1;
    ke = 0.5*(uv*uv+vv*vv);
    p = gam1*(rE-r*ke);
    h = E+p*r1;    

    T = p/(gam1*r);
    Tphys = Tref/Tinf * T;
    Ts = 110.4;

    Tr = Tphys/Tref;
    muphys = muRef * sqrt(Tr*Tr*Tr) * (Tref + Ts)/(Tphys + Ts);    
    fc = muphys*gam/Pr;

    ux = (rux - rx*uv)*r1;
    vx = (rvx - rx*vv)*r1;
    kex = uv*ux + vv*vx;
    px = gam1*(rEx - rx*ke - r*kex);
    Tx = (px*r - p*rx)*r1*r1/gam1;
    uy = (ruy - ry*uv)*r1;
    vy = (rvy - ry*vv)*r1;
    key = uv*uy + vv*vy;
    py = gam1*(rEy - ry*ke - r*key);
    Ty = (py*r - p*ry)*r1*r1/gam1;

    f[0] = fc*Tx;
    f[1] = fc*Ty;
end

function ViscousStress(x, uhat, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)  
    output_size(f) = 3;

    gam = mu[0];
    gam1 = gam - 1.0;
    Re = mu[1];
    Pr = mu[2];
    Minf = mu[3];
    Tref = mu[9];
    muRef = 1/Re;
    M2 = Minf*Minf;
    c23 = 2.0/3.0;
    pinf = 1.0/(gam*M2);
    Tinf = pinf/(gam-1.0);

    r = uhat[0];
    ru = uhat[1];
    rv = uhat[2];
    rE = uhat[3];
    rx = uq[4];
    rux = uq[5];
    rvx = uq[6];
    rEx = uq[7];
    ry = uq[8];
    ruy = uq[9];
    rvy = uq[10];
    rEy = uq[11];

    av = v[0];

    r1 = 1/r;
    uv = ru*r1;
    vv = rv*r1;
    E = rE*r1;
    ke = 0.5*(uv*uv+vv*vv);
    p = gam1*(rE-r*ke);
    h = E+p*r1;    

    T = p/(gam1*r);
    Tphys = Tref/Tinf * T;
    Ts = 110.4;

    Tr = Tphys/Tref;
    muphys = muRef * sqrt(Tr*Tr*Tr) * (Tref + Ts)/(Tphys + Ts);    
    fc = muphys*gam/Pr;

    ux = (rux - rx*uv)*r1;
    vx = (rvx - rx*vv)*r1;
    kex = uv*ux + vv*vx;
    px = gam1*(rEx - rx*ke - r*kex);
    Tx = (px*r - p*rx)*r1*r1/gam1;
    uy = (ruy - ry*uv)*r1;
    vy = (rvy - ry*vv)*r1;
    key = uv*uy + vv*vy;
    py = gam1*(rEy - ry*ke - r*key);
    Ty = (py*r - p*ry)*r1*r1/gam1;

    y = x[1];
    f[0] = muphys*c23*(2*ux - vy + vv/y);
    f[1] = muphys*(uy + vx);
    f[2] = muphys*c23*(2*vy - ux + vv/y);
end

function Fint(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, tau, eta, mu, t)
    output_size(fb) = 5;

    gam = mu[0];
    gam1 = gam - 1.0;
    Re = mu[1];
    Pr = mu[2];
    Minf = mu[3];
    Tref = mu[9];
    muRef = 1/Re;
    M2 = Minf*Minf;
    c23 = 2.0/3.0;
    pinf = 1.0/(gam*M2);
    Tinf = pinf/(gam-1.0);

    URef = 2500;
    R = 287;
    Ts = 110.4;
    T0 = 273.15;
    mu0 = 1.716e-5;
    Tr = Tref/T0;
    muPhys = mu0 * sqrt(Tr*Tr*Tr) * (T0 + Ts)/(Tref + Ts);    
    
    RhoRef = Re*muPhys/URef;
    PRef = RhoRef*R*Tref;
    qfactor = PRef*URef*gam*Minf*Minf;
    stressfactor = RhoRef*URef*URef;

    r = uq[0];
    ru = uq[1];
    rv = uq[2];
    rE = uq[3];
    rx = uq[4];
    rux = uq[5];
    rvx = uq[6];
    rEx = uq[7];
    ry = uq[8];
    ruy = uq[9];
    rvy = uq[10];
    rEy = uq[11];

    uv = ru/r;
    vv = rv/r;

    ke = 0.5*(uv*uv+vv*vv);
    p = gam1*(rE-r*ke);
    T = p/(gam1*r);
    Tphys = Tref/Tinf * T;
    Rhophys = RhoRef * r;
    Pphys = Rhophys * R * Tphys;
    
    f = HeatFlux(x, uhat, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t);
    s = ViscousStress(x, uhat, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t);

    qn_nd = f[0]*n[0] + f[1]*n[1] + tau[0]*(uq[3] - uhat[3]);
    fb[0] = qn_nd * qfactor; 
    s1 = uhat[1]/uhat[0];
    s2 = uhat[2]/uhat[0]; 
    fb[1] = Pphys;    
    fb[2] = s[0]*stressfactor;
    fb[3] = s[1]*stressfactor;
    fb[4] = s[2]*stressfactor;
end

function Fext(x, uq, v, w, uhat, n, uext, tau, eta, mu, t)
    output_size(fb) = 4;
    
    gam = mu[0];
    gam1 = gam - 1.0;
    Re = mu[1];
    Tinf = mu[8];
    Tref = mu[9];
    Twall = mu[10];
    EisoW = Twall/Tref * Tinf;    
    Ewall = uext[0]/Tref * Tinf;
    
    URef = 2500.0;
    Ts = 110.4;
    T0 = 273.15;
    mu0 = 1.716e-5;
    Tr = Tref/T0;
    muPhys = mu0 * sqrt(Tr*Tr*Tr) * (T0 + Ts)/(Tref + Ts);
    RhoRef = Re*muPhys/URef;
    mdot = uext[1] / (RhoRef * URef);

    fb[0] = uq[0] - uhat[0]; 
    fb[1] = -mdot*n[0] - uhat[1]; 
    fb[2] = -mdot*n[1] - uhat[2]; 

    r = uhat[0];
    ru = -mdot*n[0];
    rv = -mdot*n[1];
    ke = 0.5*(ru*ru + rv*rv)/r;
    fb[3] = uhat[0]*Ewall + ke - uhat[3];
end

function VisScalars(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)  

  gam = mu[0];
  gam1 = gam - 1.0;
  Re = mu[1];
  Pr = mu[2];
  Minf = mu[3];
  Tref = mu[9];
  muRef = 1/Re;
  M2 = Minf*Minf;
  c23 = 2.0/3.0;
  pinf = 1.0/(gam*M2);
  Tinf = pinf/(gam-1.0);
  pInfPhys = mu[11];

  r = uq[0];
  ru = uq[1];
  rv = uq[2];
  rE = uq[3];
  rx = uq[4];
  rux = uq[5];
  rvx = uq[6];
  rEx = uq[7];
  ry = uq[8];
  ruy = uq[9];
  rvy = uq[10];
  rEy = uq[11];

  uv = ru/r;
  vv = rv/r;

  ke = 0.5*(uv*uv+vv*vv);
  p = gam1*(rE-r*ke);
  T = p/(gam1*r);
  Tphys = Tref/Tinf * T;
  URef = 2500;
  T0 = 273.15;
  Ts = 110.4;
  mu0 = 1.716e-5;
  Tr = Tref/T0;
  muPhys = mu0 * sqrt(Tr*Tr*Tr) * (T0 + Ts)/(Tref + Ts); 
  RhoRef = Re*muPhys/URef;
  Rhophys = RhoRef * r;
  R = 287;
  pphys = Rhophys * R * Tphys;

  output_size(s) = 10;
  s[0] = r;
  s[1] = uv;
  s[2] = vv;  
  s[3] = p;
  s[4] = T;
  s[5] = Rhophys;
  s[6] = URef*uv;
  s[7] = URef*vv;
  s[8] = pphys;  
  s[9] = Tphys;  
end

function VisVectors(x, uq, v, w, eta, mu, t)  
  output_size(s) = 2;
  s[0] = uq[1];
  s[1] = uq[2];  
end
